description: `halt on` (cli.py cmd_halt, config.write_fleet_halt) writes the fleet-wide pause file beside the resolved config; a later `sweep --tick` still prints the reconcile/reclaim line for every project (the halt note in cmd_halt's own help: 'sweep still records and reclaims settled tasks') but takes the `elif args.tick` branch (cli.py ~13103-13105) instead of `_sweep_tick_orchestrator`, printing a flat `<project>: skipped (fleet halted)` per project with no orchestrator pane read or send at all — distinct from `sweep-dry-run-preview`, which previews the reconcile/reclaim leg itself rather than the tick-skip leg.
